texts.backup_limit: Windows backups and restore points can keep a copy of Halvo's data that deleting it in Halvo does not remove.
texts.custody: Windows protects the key that protects your data with your account.
texts.limits: A copy of Halvo's data made earlier, such as a backup, keeps what it held: expiry does not reach it, and after a delete-all a copy of the whole data folder can still be read.
texts.passwords: Halvo observes no typing on Windows in this version, so it records nothing that you type into a password field.

recorded.text: Halvo records the title text of the window in front; the title of a private window is not stored where Halvo can tell the window is private.
Typing is not observed on Windows in this version.
Halvo records a class for each click or scroll, never its position.

texts.storage: Halvo keeps at most 25 GB and removes the oldest days first when it reaches that.
